# Parker Swearngin LLC

> Parker Swearngin is a CPA-led accounting, tax, payroll, and advisory firm in Lee's Summit, MO, serving individuals and businesses across the Kansas City metro, Missouri, and Kansas. It focuses on law firms, service-based businesses and subcontractors, professional services, real estate brokers, medical professionals, and veterinarians. What sets it apart: a team approach with close analysis and personal attention, seasoned tax professionals, and bundled services for a fixed monthly fee so there are no billing surprises.
